# Energy Quantization (Planck Formulation)

Energy levels in a bound quantum harmonic system are discrete rather than continuous. Max Planck resolved the ultraviolet catastrophe by postulating that electromagnetic radiation is emitted in discrete quanta of energy $E = h\nu$.
